name: CineDock
description: A cinematic, television-first interface for the Emby, Jellyfin or Plex server you already run. CineDock uses your existing users and libraries and includes a plain-English setup wizard.

paths.name: Config folder
paths.description: Where CineDock stores its server connection and small caches.

ports.name: Web port
ports.description: The port you open in your browser to use CineDock.

variables.name: TMDB API key (optional)
variables.description: Optional. A free TMDB key adds actor biographies, filmographies and trailer fallback. CineDock works without it, and it can also be added later in Settings.
